programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E01
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. The Clarks are trying to achieve their goal - to find 80 ounces, or over 2 kg, of gold this season. They seek their fortune in an abandoned mine on Jack's Hill. Vern and Leon want to take advantage of an expiring gold mining license. The problem is that the permit covers a remote location. So the partners set off on a crazy race against time through the Australian bush. Kellie and her companion search in the wild wilderness. The harsh nature and 40-degree heat take their toll on them. To achieve their goal of 50 ounces of gold, the friends risk their lives. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E02
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. programme.title: The fastest predators – Invisible hunters | E02
programme.desc: In a fight between a predator, the creators of the program explore how deception and speed of action can mean the difference between life and death. Even the fastest hunters use tricks to deceive their prey. Australia. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Lion Rules – Adapt or Die | E02
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. A pride of lions goes hunting during a difficult drought period. Einstein tries to get used to living alone. The lioness Kalwezi is desperately fighting for the life of her cubs. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Face to face – Sharks | E01
programme.desc: Rodolphe Guignard is a photographer and diver. He travels the world to meet predators and come face to face with them. He will see orcas, crocodiles, sharks and people living next to these majestic animals up close... France. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Bison: an American icon
programme.desc: Buffalo can be considered a symbol of the wild areas found in North America. The documentary will present the development of one of the representatives of this extraordinary species... Germany. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: Greater Africa – Mashatu Reserve | E04
programme.desc: An extraordinary and fascinating adventure in the last wild, majestic deserts of Africa. The creators present a completely new look at the wonders of the Dark Continent and its amazing nature. The Mashatu Reserve exists thanks to the life-giving power of the great Limpopo River, around which large herds of Africa's most characteristic wild animals live. South Africa. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: David Attenborough: songs of life
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough selects seven of the most extraordinary recordings from the natural world and explores what these sounds mean to specific animal species. Each song - from that of a lemur, through the song of a humpback whale or a lyrebird from the order of passerine birds - was recorded during the lifetime of a famous naturalist who recorded and analyzed these songs for decades. The oldest recording was made when Sir David was five years old, the latest just a few years before the documentary was created. Each has an amazing story behind it and shows how much we still don't know about the natural world. When Sir David Attenborough was born, the science of song was transformed under Charles Darwin's theory of sexual selection, which labeled singing dangerous because it revealed the singer's location to predators. The same song also gives males a great chance to be noticed by the female and thus to pass on their genes to the next generation of birds. So the males sing, and the females listen and choose the best singers because, according to them, they will be the best fathers. New scientific trends in bird song are challenging these long-held ideas. Scientists invited to the program show that in fact, in most species of songbirds, females create their own songs - and only now do they have a chance to be truly heard. However, there is a concern whether we will be able to learn all the songs of these extraordinary birds - the human loss is loud, and the planet Earth is falling silently, as the host of the program also warns. The production is a continuation of the documentary film nominated for the Grierson Award. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Our evil winter – Circle of life | E04
programme.desc: The program will analyze adaptations, predation, survival instinct and mating behavior of animals inhabiting the incredibly frosty regions of our planet. Animals have evolved and adapted their behavior to survive even the most demanding winter conditions. Only in this way could they pass on their genes, thus ensuring the survival of their species. Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Alaska: Four Seasons – Fall | E04
programme.desc: Autumn has come and it's getting colder. Wild animals are making final preparations for winter. Time is running out - autumn in the far north is short. Great Britain. 2017. documentary series

programme.title: Brown hyenas
programme.desc: The documentary focuses on the struggle for survival in the harsh terrain of Botswana. Endangered brown hyenas live there all year round, trying to function normally. Nothing is wasted because hyenas eat whatever they can find. Representatives of this family bring skin, bones and feathers to the cave where the puppies are waiting... South Africa. 2021. documentary film

programme.title: Sharks vs. killer whales
programme.desc: The great white shark is not at the top of the food chain. His power means he could be on it. However, killer whale attacks made them the kings of the oceans. The creators will take a look at these majestic creatures and wonder if sharks have any chance against them... Great Britain. 2025. documentary film

programme.title: With! | E01
programme.desc: The creators will use the help of hunters and animal tracking experts and will set off on a 3-day expedition. Their goal is to find some of the largest sharks in the world... Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Summer | E04
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Summer is a time of plenty for most animals - but not for polar bears. These predators cannot hunt seals until the sea freezes over. They are getting hungrier every day. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Elway to Marino
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

S1, Ep3 «Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs»…This episode focuses on the remarkable partnerships between dogs and their (mostly) human partners. programme.title: d/s Best friends. 5 s.
programme.desc: Chocolate retriever Sasha and two hairless guinea pigs Sheldon and Spencer live a great life. Australian Shepherd Lincoln protects a calf named Kelvin. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Starring: Sara Marino, Scott Bainbridge. Canada, 2014

programme.title: d/s Best friends. 6 p.
programme.desc: Mini horse Spanky gets a new chance thanks to Jack Russell terrier Dally. And a King Charles cavalier named Lola found solace with her best friend, Pepper Rabbit. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Starring: Sara Marino, Scott Bainbridge. Canada, 2014

programme.title: d/s Best friends. Seamus, Puck, Amani and Winsper
programme.desc: Rescued mountain dog Seamus befriends a Maine Coon. At the Dallas Zoo, friendly Labrador Amani makes the perfect partner for shy and restless cheetah Winsper. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Starring: Sara Marino, Scott Bainbridge. Canada, 2014

programme.title: d/s Ingenious sea hunters. Alaska/Norway
programme.desc: Whales in Alaska are organizing a joint hunt while others battle killer whales for herring off the coast of Norway. Killer whales surround schools of fish underwater and invent an underwater box. France, 2020

programme.title: In the animal world. 17 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/f The Last Giraffe
programme.desc: Each episode of the program will tell about the beautiful giraffes, which are endangered due to the reduction of their natural habitat, poaching and extreme climatic factors. We will share stories of animals who face these problems. Dir.: Laurent Frapat. France, 2018

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. wetlands
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Desert
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 3 s.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. The heroes of the series are the most creative, aggressive and inquisitive representatives of the fauna, surprising with their instincts and habits. Dir.: Kala Ellis. Australia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 4 s.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. The heroes of the series are the most creative, aggressive and inquisitive representatives of the fauna, surprising with their instincts and habits. Dir.: Kala Ellis. Australia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Amazing animal families. 4 s.
programme.desc: Playful learning is also a fundamentally important skill in the animal kingdom. Panda cubs are a prime example of this. Cute bear cubs “study” in a group. Australia, 2019

programme.title: d/f Wild Borneo
programme.desc: Sabah is the heart of Borneo, an island shrouded in fog and mystery. This region, whose jungle is over 130 million years old, is impressive with its high mountains and mysterious rivers. Ancient rainforests and a unique ecosystem hide rare species of animals and plants, creating a unique world that makes you admire Borneo's wildlife. 2015

programme.title: d/s Galapagossa. At the edge of the Earth. Survival
programme.desc: It is home to many species of plants and animals that are found nowhere else on the planet. Unfortunately, due to human activity and climate change, some species have become endangered. Dir.: Chan Won-joon. South Korea, 2018

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Born Warriors
programme.desc: Males and females of some animals fight each other mercilessly. They do not have the goal of killing each other, although this sometimes happens. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Run faster than the wind
programme.desc: Due to the constant hunting of predators, prey must adapt and develop defensive skills, otherwise they will face a sad fate. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Return of the disappeared. Return of the Tiger
programme.desc: The series is about how nature restores balance after human intervention. The story of how Amur tigers, beavers, leopards and other species that were on the verge of extinction began to thrive again. The restoration of ecosystems and the return of extinct species is the result of the joint efforts of scientists, environmental organizations and people who care about preserving our planet. South Korea, 2023

programme.title: d/s On the seabed. 1 p.
programme.desc: In this project you will meet great white sharks, colorful cuttlefish and playful sea lions. From mysterious jellyfish and shy squid to giant whales and cunning octopuses, we explore the amazing stories of survival and evolution of marine inhabitants, their interaction in the ocean environment. 2021

programme.title: d/s On the verge of extinction. Mediterranean
programme.desc: Every day, about 200 species of plants and animals leave the planet, accelerating the process of the sixth mass extinction. It is important to act to preserve biodiversity by protecting the natural centers of life that are located in different parts of the world. This project shows how life on Earth depends on the preservation of these ecosystems. UK, 2018

programme.title: d/s Wild China. 2 s.
programme.desc: The city, as one of the ecosystems on Earth, was the last to be born. It was created to satisfy human needs, but other living beings also strive to find their living space here. The Temple of Heaven is home to many animals. 2018

programme.title: d/s Wild Thailand. Hunter game
programme.desc: In the cloudy rainforests, fertile wetlands and bustling cities of Thailand, wild animals engage in an eternal battle to the death to find prey or to avoid becoming dinner. Their survival depends on intelligence, cunning and ingenuity. 2014

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Early bird
programme.desc: Frantic chases are what awaits the viewer as he watches a predator attack its prey from the air, while the latter tries to avoid a pitiful fate. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Reptiles
programme.desc: Crocodiles are descended from animals that roamed the Earth 250 million years ago. And snakes use the sun to control their temperature throughout their lives. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/f Earth
programme.desc: The story of how people's perception of nature has changed over the millennia - from first impressions to modern attitudes that often seem indifferent. Accompanying viewers in searching for an answer to the question of how we should look at life around us, the film emphasizes the importance of a respectful and conscious attitude towards nature in preserving our future. France, 2015

programme.title: d/f Beyond the horizon: Wildlife of Saudi Arabia
programme.desc: Saudi Arabia is discovering its amazing natural resources. The documentary features rare species including Arabian leopards, gazelles and oryxes, and how they are conserved in the wild. The camera demonstrates the unique habits of these animals and the efforts of scientists and ecologists aimed at protecting and restoring populations. Saudi Arabia, 2024

programme.title: d/f Wild Australia
programme.desc: Australia is not only a continent with a unique nature, but also home to many rare and amazing species of flora and fauna. The project explores ecosystems, amazing natural phenomena and the lives of the most unusual animals living in the Australian wild. France, 2024

programme.title: d/f Albatross and Penguin
programme.desc: In the midst of the short summer on the Falkland Islands, albatrosses and penguins face different fates, but both species have one common goal - to raise their chicks. On these lands of the South Atlantic, a real struggle for procreation is unfolding, where birds rush to fulfill an important mission in a limited time. France

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Great Desert Race
programme.desc: Desert animals have evolved to survive in hot, dry conditions. Like scorpions, which have existed since the beginning of life. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Herbivores
programme.desc: The African savanna has seen thousands of different battles. How do elephants survive on a diet that would bring any vegetarian to their knees? Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/f Return of the birds of the lake
programme.desc: Birds are constantly fighting for survival, finding food, choosing partners and nesting sites in an industrial city where life was almost destroyed two decades ago. In this film we will see how nature and animals adapt to harsh conditions and recover despite the influence of human activity. Slovenia, 2018

programme.title: d/s Ingenious sea hunters. Adapt or die
programme.desc: In Argentina, Mariano faces a feud between seagulls and whales, while biologist Ingrid has been studying sea lions on the Skeleton Coast in Namibia for many years. France, 2020

programme.title: d/s Esteros Nature Reserve in focus. First day

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Matriarch Dagmar goes into labor after 15 months of pregnancy. Meanwhile, the Sumatran orangutan troop is recovering from the fire that devastated their habitat last year. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The population of Asian short-clawed otters has grown rapidly. Mother Annie and father Wallace can sit back and relax. At the dik-dik antelopes, Khari and Shani have a baby. (Station info).

programme.title: Baby-Tiere
programme.desc: Baby orangutans roam the forests of Southeast Asia. Asian elephant calves have fun in the mud and a rare red-shanked duk shows off his tree surfing skills. (Station info).

programme.title: Baby-Tiere
programme.desc: In Africa, the documentary filmmaker captures lion cubs on their forays and observes pygmy hippos hunting for something to eat. Baby camels show how to really romp. (Station info).

programme.title: Expedition am Limit mit Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Steve Backshall ventures on an expedition to Kamchatka with kayak professionals. On the wild Kronotsky River they encounter untouched nature - and grizzlies that have never seen humans. (Station info).

programme.title: Expedition am Limit mit Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Adventure underground: Steve explores a huge lava tube system in Saudi Arabia with experts - and starts in the mysterious Nabataean city of Hegra. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of crocodiles and hippos with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Are hippos really as aggressive as their reputation suggests? Steve Backshall meets them in Africa and discovers an amazing connection with whales. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of crocodiles and hippos with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Are hippos beasts that kill 500 people a year? Steve gets to the bottom of the matter and discovers how important they are to the ecosystem and meets them up close - even in gardens. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: For three years, the two lion brothers of the Nsefu pride dominated Luangwa National Park. Now several rivals see their chance to put an early end to the duo's reign. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: After a period of sheltered growing up, hyena Mizumu is on her own. Now the fight for survival begins for the young male. Can he brave the numerous dangers of the wilderness? (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: The wild dog offspring slowly loses its umbilical cord and explores the world on its own. Of the large pack, only three adults and six young remain. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: Hyena Spotty fights for dominance in her pack. She has to assert herself against her dominant mother. Will she be able to bond with other family members? (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The Rothschild giraffe herd is expecting another newcomer. Wendy and Bob, a pair of tragopans and pheasants, are still eagerly waiting for offspring. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Thanks to male Roy, the endangered species of chocolate poison dart frogs is slowly recovering at Chester Zoo. Edna, an Asian wood turtle, needs medical attention for her teeth. (Station info).

programme.title: Beacon of life
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough presents animals that produce light to attract prey or scare off enemies.

programme.title: Fabulous world of frogs
programme.desc: The documentary shows sensational and first-filmed behaviors of frogs all over the globe: flying tree frogs in South America, shaggy water frogs and African bullfrogs. A strange and bizarre world.

programme.title: David Attenborough: The Sound of Nature
programme.desc: The Emmy and Bafta award winner certainly can't warble as well as the gibbons singing in the new BBC documentary. While whale music is well known but its meaning is barely deciphered, wolf howling serves as a means of communication and warning.

programme.title: David Attenborough – The Mystery of the Giant Egg
programme.desc: How can the diversity of our animal world be preserved? Using the example of the extinct elephant bird, nature film legend Sir David Attenborough looks for answers in Madagascar. (Station info).

programme.title: Forest of wild ponies
programme.desc: Great Britain's second-smallest national park in the south of the country has a lot to offer: The New Forest has served as a hunting ground since 1079 for King William the Conqueror (1027/28–1087). Since then, residents' livestock have been allowed to move freely in the forest and agriculture in the area has been stopped. Around 4,500 very special residents, the New Forest ponies, actively manage the landscape here alongside cattle, donkeys, pigs and sheep. The historic forest is therefore seen as a model for how species-rich landscapes in the middle of Europe can be preserved in the future. Apart from the deciduous and mixed forest, meadows and heathland make up over half of the nature reserve.

programme.title: Spines, fur and feathers
programme.desc: Fur, feathers, scales, mussel shells: They are all part of the outer layer of a living being. Most of the time they also ensure survival. How have these shells evolved over millions of years? (Station info).

programme.title: Cats up close
programme.desc: (GB 14). Cat content makes you happy: the secret to the success of cat videos viewed millions of times. The documentary shows what our most popular pet can do, from hunting to swimming. The sweet factor comes on all by itself...

programme.title: Wonderful world of the Pacific & wild Antarctica
programme.desc: With the start of the Antarctic winter, whales and seabirds migrate to warmer climes, but not the emperor penguin. The majestic tailcoats begin to hatch their eggs. (Station info).

programme.title: The Tuamotu Islands: natural wonders in the South Seas
programme.desc: This underwater world is unparalleled: the Tumakohua Pass, in the southern part of the Fakarava Atoll. The moon and the tides determine the fate of many animal species here. (Station info).

Nhưng sau một thời gian dài, người đàn ông mà cô tìm thấy đã trở thành một người xa lạ. programme.desc: Vị cứu tinh của mọi người, Stone Monkey, đã mang lại hy vọng cho một cô bé tuyệt vọng mà anh hứa sẽ nhận ra. Nhiều năm sau, Stone Monkey bị đánh bại trong trận chiến với Thần chiến tranh ba mắt, khiến hắn mất đi sức mạnh và rơi xuống phàm trần. Liệu anh ta có thể thực hiện lời hứa của mình với cô gái và ngăn chặn Thần Rừng hủy diệt trái đất?

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời thử nghiệm sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: HỎA VÂN TÀ THẦN: MẶT NẠ TU LA - THE MASK OF SHURA OF FIRE CLOUD
programme.desc: 18 năm trước, tộc Black Feather độc ác đã xâm nhập vào lãnh thổ của Master Fire Cloud và đánh cắp Mặt nạ Shura, từ đó giải phóng một linh hồn tà ác là một đứa bé. Master Fire Cloud đã nhận nuôi đứa bé để ngăn cậu trở thành ác quỷ. Khi đứa bé lớn lên, nó nắm quyền điều khiển chiếc mặt nạ và trở thành người kế nhiệm Fire Cloud với tư cách là người bảo vệ thành phố.

programme.title: GIÁO PHÁI BÁO THÙ - WU LIN: THE SOCIETY
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 2050, nơi tình trạng ô nhiễm và virus tràn lan buộc mọi người phải đeo khẩu trang chỉ để thở, tuy nhiên cuộc sống hàng ngày vẫn tiếp tục như thường lệ. Khi hàng loạt cái chết bí ẩn nổ ra, cảnh sát nghi ngờ kẻ giết người hàng loạt trong khi có tin đồn về một con quỷ đang nổi cơn thịnh nộ. Giờ đây, cảnh sát phải chạy đua để làm sáng tỏ bí ẩn và ngăn chặn các vụ giết người trước khi sự hoảng loạn bao trùm thành phố.
